verdicts.evidence: All 12 quoted sites now carry 'The arguments are:' bulleted lists. A script parsing every docstring signature in src/ext for 3+/kw args found zero unbulleted violators; the 3 remaining prose-form docstrings each take exactly 2 positional args, correctly under threshold.

args_form.jl:7 now defines ARGS_BULLET as a whitespace-tolerant regex r"The\s+arguments\s+are:" (was a literal substring), with a comment citing this exact line-wrap reason. Scan.jl and Preflight.jl still wrap the phrase across a line break; \s matches newlines so it now matches both.

args_form.jl:16-31 replaced findfirst/findlast with a paren-depth walk that finds the argument list's true matching close-paren, so a `-> (a,b,c)` return tuple can no longer pollute the parsed parameter list. Comment explains this replaces arrow-stripping, which was unsound for arrow-valued defaults.
Preflight.jl:203-205: 'needs holds the requirement tags (html, git, rulebook) not_applicable is computed from' — needs is now explained inline like every sibling field.
code_in_math.jl:3 now reads 'braced subscripts and superscripts of any length', matching the actual _\{[a-z]+\} regex (unbounded +), no longer claiming 'one-letter subscripts'.
